source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Saudi Arabia 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch write-up describes every mark on the shirt: the SAFF crest and adidas logo in white on the chest, a gold palm tree motif on the upper back beneath the collar, and matching green shorts and socks, and names no commercial sponsor; the launch photos published with the article show the shirt front and sleeves with only the SAFF crest and adidas logo.
source.quote: Purple detailing appears throughout the design, while the crest and adidas logo sit on the chest in a contrasting white finish.

summary: adidas home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle. No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the SAFF crest, adidas branding and a gold palm tree motif on the upper back beneath the collar, with matching green shorts and socks, and names no commercial sponsor; the launch photos published with the article show the shirt front and sleeves with no commercial marks.
